editorial.blurb: Rudy's Ramen delivers impressive broths and chewy noodles that keep neighbors coming back, though execution can be inconsistent across the menu.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the Spicy Miso or Spicy Tonkotsu ramen and pair it with the karaage chicken (marinated 24 hours, breaded fresh)—skip the pork bun, which reviewers found dry and underwhelming.
